about: One call of the live host tool compare_model_observation (mcp__virtualcell__compare_model_observation), for the M1 comparison. A cross-check of the product path, not part of the decision's input.
input: The M1 arguments of run_comparison.py, with the window reduced to the pMEK target and without the window's limits and final_step_only fields, to keep the payload to 6,037 bytes of compact JSON. Typed into the tool call by the host.

local_same_input.explanation: The host input had the PBS reading as the integer 1 where the built input has 1.0. That changes observations_sha256 and so comparison_id; the link hash, the outcome and every other field are the same. With the same bytes, local and host give the same comparison_id.

what_this_shows: The host's tool returns the same outcome as the in-process product call for this input.

The host's response carries observed_vocabulary and observed_categories, so it serves code at least as recent as review r1; the cached tool description seen by the host does not list observed_vocabulary. The exact deployed commit is not established.
not_done: The M2 comparison was not sent to the host (one representative call). No other host tool was called.
